name: Do I need to move furniture before interior painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move furniture before interior painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: While we take precautions to protect your belongings, it is helpful if you remove smaller, valuable, or fragile items from the rooms to be painted. Our team will handle moving larger furniture to the center of the room and covering it securely with plastic sheeting to prevent paint splatters. Clearing surfaces and pathways beforehand allows our painters to work more efficiently and ensures the safety of your possessions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Please remove small, valuable items. Our team will move and cover larger furniture to protect it during painting.
